name: vietacademia
description: A directory of Vietnamese professors worldwide.

scripts.predev: npm run assign-profile-ids && npm run sync-profile-css && npm run build-stats-history && node scripts/generate-profile-pages.ts --dev
scripts.prebuild: npm run assign-profile-ids && npm run sync-profile-css && npm run build-stats-history
scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/generate-profile-pages.ts && node scripts/slim-public-data.ts
scripts.pretest: npm run stamp-updates && npm run sync-profile-css && npm run format
scripts.test: npm run validate-data && npm run typecheck && node --test 'test/*.test.ts'
